question: What status may the practitioner attain through the desired ritual accomplishment?
premises: The practice aims at attaining what the practitioner desires.
The result is compared to one born at a god's feet.
This comparison indicates a high divine-like status.
inference: Through attaining the desired object, the practitioner may become equal to one born at the feet of the gods.
uncertainties: sura-aṅghri-pa-samaḥ may imply an attendant of the gods or a being of similar rank
plain_english: By this, for the attainment of what the practitioner desires, one may become equal to one born at the feet of the gods.
